requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4247-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4247-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

813-4113-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by tapping Scholar of the Ages due to Essence Flux's convoke ability, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6096-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6096-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating at least one creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-2728-4153-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
997-2728-4153-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
997-2728-4153-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-5233-7885.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

129-1632-1978-5793.description:
Activate Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Stonespeaker Crystal which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

2626-2829-4986--44.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2173-2469-5220-6273.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-5879-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1169-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2921-3585-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6823-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6823-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4506-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Auriok Champion triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4506-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

3330-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-4017-4186.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3951-4192-5703-6753.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4192-5703-6753.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2724-3080-5299-5900.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {1}{G}{U} each extra turn
2724-3080-5299-5900.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

1-2275-5435-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2275-5435-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

1268-2034-4871-4917.easyPrerequisites: Crab Umbra attached to Jan Jansen.
1268-2034-4871-4917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
1268-2034-4871-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Construct tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Constructs die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

1308-3484-3921-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1308-3484-3921-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

222-527-647-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-647-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

341-1698-3260-3540.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
341-1698-3260-3540.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
341-1698-3260-3540.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

1140-1636-3143-4136.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-4136.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

67-2292-2525.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers its Reveillark ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

190-389-2964.notablePrerequisites: Root Greevil does not have summoning sickness.
190-389-2964.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Nine Lives.
When Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Root Greevil by paying {2}{G} tapping and sacrificing it, destroying all white enchantments.
When aach opponent's Nine Lives leave the battlefield, they trigger, causing them to lose the game.

505-4050-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
505-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Izoni, adding {1}.
Izoni dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Izoni from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Izoni enters the battlefield, creating at least four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Insects, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature tokens and mana, you can use that to activate Izoni's ability to draw infinite cards.

1050-4068-4439-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Nevinyrral's Disk's ability by paying {1} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mairsil using Aetherling's first ability by paying {U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield at beginning of the next end step.
Resolve the Nevinyrral's Disk's ability, destroying all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments.
Repeat.

950-1671-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
950-1671-3525.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
